plot predictions from phylosem

Source: R/predict.R
plot.predict_phylosem.Rd

plot the predictive distribution for one or two variables extracted using predict.phylosem

Usage

# S3 method for class 'predict_phylosem'
plot(x, y, variables = 1, data, data_labels, distance_threshold = 0, tree, ...)

Arguments

x

Output from predict.phylosem

y

Not used

variables

which variables to plot (can only plot one or two at a time)

data

optional data.frame of fitted data e.g., fit$data

data_labels

For each row of data, listing the corresponding name from tree$tip.label. Default pulls data_labels from rownames(data)

distance_threshold

distance from taxa to use when plotting data

tree

phylogenetic structure, using class as.phylo

...

Not used
